answer: Sybil resistance by vesting escrow: route every payout through Sable, an escrow that releases funds only after 100 epochs of clean history, audited by Opal, a per-identity fraud detector, against Ocean, the shared identity graph. A puppet's payoff is near zero on day one. An attacker running N puppets must lock capital in Sable for each one - no pooling, no batch discount - and a single Opal flag freezes all N escrows. Honest agents wait once and keep the full amount; the attacker pays N frozen deposits plus certain forfeiture.
